subject: DPA & SCC pathing — controller/processor alignment and SOC 2 status
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Price <sam.price@medalign.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Aug 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: DPA & SCC pathing — controller/processor alignment and SOC 2 status

Hi Samuel —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and next steps on the privacy/security track so we can keep procurement moving: 

- Roles: you mentioned MedAlign will be acting as the controller for patient-matching use cases; please confirm.
- SOC 2: can you share current status (Type I/II, date issued) and any timelines?
- Vendor questionnaire: thanks for the questionnaire — if you can upload the completed workbook we’ll run it through our security ops.
- DPA/SCC: our standard approach is to align on controller/processor roles and then pick the appropriate SCC module (most commonly Module Two for controller -> processor). If you want, we can send a short DPA draft with the recommended SCC module for review.

Next steps I propose:
1) Samuel — confirm role (controller/processor) and attach your vendor sec questionnaire (if not already sent).
2) Naomi (cc’d) — I’ve looped you in to confirm Redwood’s SOC 2 status and recommend SCC module.
3) Laura — legal to prepare a short DPA draft we can share with MedAlign once roles are confirmed.

Target: get roles and questionnaire on file this week so Legal/Security can finalize the DPA and SCC selection.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

Thanks — quick answers below:
- Role: MedAlign will be the controller for the patient-matching flow; Redwood will be processor.
- SOC2: we completed SOC 2 Type II in June 2026; I’m attaching our questionnaire export and can provide a restricted link to our report via our security portal if needed.

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Price <sam.price@medalign.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA & SCC pathing — controller/processor alignment and SOC 2 status

Hi Sam / Marissa —

Thanks for confirming, Sam — that alignment makes sense. A few security notes from Redwood’s side: 

- SOC 2: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II audit (security + availability) in May 2026. We can share a redacted report with MedAlign under an NDA; link below is to the secure copy.
- SCC recommendation: for controller -> processor relationships we recommend SCC Module Two (Controller -> Processor). That provides the appropriate obligations for processors acting on behalf of controllers. If MedAlign requires a different arrangement (e.g., controller-controller), we can discuss but this will require changes to dataflow and contractual language.
- DPA draft: I’ve prepared and attached a short DPA draft (redlined for Module Two) that Laura can take a look at. The DPA includes: subprocessing, deletion/return timelines (default 90 days unless otherwise agreed), audit rights (reasonable notice), and a data mapping appendix placeholder.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type_II_Redacted_202606.pdf; Redwood_DPA_Draft_MedAlign_20270810.docx

Open questions for MedAlign:
1) Do you have any special retention or data residency requirements beyond the 90-day default?
2) Any additional security controls (e.g., dedicated VPC, customer-managed keys) you expect to require in contract?

If you share answers we’ll surface any hard blockers early.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
[Link to SOC2 (redacted): https://files.redwood.example/soc2/redacted-report]
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Price <sam.price@medalign.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA & SCC pathing — controller/processor alignment and SOC 2 status

Hi Sam —

Appreciate the quick answers. From a contracting perspective I reviewed Naomi’s Module Two redline and a few items for the MedAlign legal team to consider: 

- Retention/erasure: our standard is 90 days for backup retention and secure deletion on termination; we can negotiate a shorter window but need to confirm the impact on availability and support.
- Data responsibilities: Module Two presumes controller-defined purposes/means — please confirm in writing which datasets (IDs, patient-matching hashes, logs) MedAlign expects Redwood to process. That mapping will be appended to the DPA.
- Subprocessors: we will list third-party subprocessors in Exhibit B and accept reasonable objection rights with a cure period.

If MedAlign can confirm retention timelines and provide the data-scope mapping, I’ll circulate a finalized DPA + SCC module selection for signature (DocuSign link to follow).

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
[Attachment: draft-dpa-redlines-visible.docx (docx)]
